```{r}
library(Seurat)
#library(clusterProfiler)
library(CellChat)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
#library(limma)
library(introdataviz)
library(ggtext)
library(ComplexHeatmap)

sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class=="Peritoneal endometriosis"&
                           !sc$harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type%in%c("Erythrocytes","Exclude")))
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%mutate(has_LA=ifelse(LA_per_Sample>0,"LA+","LA-"))
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_remove(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type," \\(.+"))%>%
  mutate(nosub=str_replace(nosub,"Memmo","Memo")%>%str_remove("Early "))
aux_table<-sc@meta.data%>%rownames_to_column("barcode")

cellcols<-c("#8DB600","#fdae61","#a95f96","#0067A5","#604E97",
            "#f46d43","black","#BE0032","cornflowerblue")
names(cellcols)<-c("B cells","Plasma cells","CD4 T cells","CD8 T cells",
                   "NK cells","Myeloid cells","unknown","Epithelial","Stroma")
lacols<-c("LA+"="#8DB600","LA-"="#f46d43",none="black")
```
# Dotplot of relevant genes
```{r}
deg<-read_csv("docs/has_laDEG-nosub_bulk-MAST.tsv")
gsea_bp<-read_csv("docs/has_laDEG-nosubbulk-GSEA-BPsimpl.csv")

i<-gsea_bp%>%filter(NES>0)%>%add_count(Description)%>%
  filter(n>4)%>%distinct(Description)%>%unlist()
i<-gsea_bp%>%filter(Description%in%i)%>%
  separate_rows(core_enrichment,sep = "/")%>%
  distinct(core_enrichment,ct)%>%
  add_count(core_enrichment)%>%filter(n>1)%>%
  distinct(core_enrichment)%>%unlist()
i<-deg%>%filter(gene%in%i)%>%group_by(gene)%>%
  summarise(up_in=sum(avg_log2FC>1),
            median_LFC=median(avg_log2FC))%>%
  filter(up_in>11&median_LFC>1)%>%distinct(gene)%>%unlist()
#i<-deg%>%filter(p_val_adj<0.05&avg_log2FC>1)%>%distinct(gene)%>%unlist()%>%c(i)

pA<-deg%>%filter(gene%in%i)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=gene,y=ct,col=avg_log2FC,size=p_val))+geom_point()+
  scale_size(range=c(5,.5),trans="log10")+
  scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "#f7f7f7", high = "#b2182b")+
  theme_classic()+theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1))+
  labs(y="",col="LFC",size="P-val")
```

# Cell chat
```{r}
cc_res<-readRDS("data/CellChat_nosubPE_hasLA.rds")
temp<-rankNet(cc_res[[1]], mode = "comparison", measure = "count", 
              sources.use = NULL, targets.use = NULL, stacked = T,
              do.stat = TRUE,return.data = T)
temp<-temp$signaling.contribution%>%as.data.frame()
temp<-cc_res[[1]]@LR$LApos$LRsig%>%
  distinct(pathway_name,annotation)%>%
  inner_join(temp,by=c("pathway_name"="name"))
temp$padj<-p.adjust(temp$pvalues)
temp<-temp%>%filter(contribution.relative.1!=Inf&
                    !(pathway_name=="MHC-I"&annotation=="Secreted Signaling"))%>%
  mutate(group=ifelse(group=="LApos","LA+","LA-"))
i<-temp%>%filter(group=="LA+")%>%arrange(annotation,contribution.relative.1)
temp<-temp%>%mutate(pathway_name=factor(pathway_name,levels=unique(i$pathway_name)))
temp<-temp%>%group_by(pathway_name)%>%
  slice_max(contribution)%>%
  mutate(group=ifelse(padj>0.05,"none",group))%>%
  ungroup()%>%add_count(pathway_name)%>%
  mutate(group=ifelse(n==2,"none",group))%>%
  mutate(groupcol=paste0("<span style='color:",
                      lacols[group],";'>",pathway_name,"</span>"))%>%
  distinct(pathway_name,groupcol)%>%right_join(temp)

pC<-temp%>%mutate(groupcol=factor(groupcol,levels=unique(groupcol)))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=groupcol,y=contribution,fill=group))+
    geom_bar(stat="identity",position = "fill")+theme_minimal()+
    facet_grid(~annotation,scales="free_x",space="free")+
    theme(axis.text.x.bottom  = element_markdown(angle=45,vjust = 1,hjust = 1),
          strip.background = element_blank())+
    labs(x="Pathway",y="Contribution",fill="Status")+
    scale_fill_manual(values=lacols)+
    geom_hline(yintercept = .5,linetype = "dashed")
```
## top pathways/ct
```{r}
pairs <- list("LA-"=subsetCommunication(cc_res$LAneg),
              "LA+"=subsetCommunication(cc_res$LApos))
pairs<-lapply(names(pairs), function(x) pairs[[x]]%>%mutate(has_LA=x))%>%bind_rows()

i<-temp%>%filter(str_detect(groupcol,"black",negate = T))%>%
  distinct(pathway_name)%>%unlist()
i<-pairs%>%filter(pathway_name%in%i&source!="Erythrocytes"&target!="Erythrocytes")%>%
  count(source,target,pathway_name,has_LA)
temp<-i%>%filter(source!=target)%>%
  unite(source:target,col="edge",sep = " - ")%>%
  separate_rows(edge,sep = " - ")
i<-i%>%filter(source==target)%>%
  mutate(edge=source)%>%select(-c(1,2))%>%bind_rows(temp)%>%
  group_by(edge,pathway_name,has_LA)%>%
  summarise(n=sum(n))

temp<-i%>%pivot_wider(names_from = has_LA,values_from = n)%>%
  mutate(across(`LA+`:`LA-`,function(x) replace_na(x,0)+0.001),
         LFC=log(`LA+`/`LA-`))%>%
  select(edge,pathway_name,LFC)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pathway_name,values_from = LFC,values_fill = 0)%>%
  column_to_rownames("edge")
temp1<-temp/apply(temp,1,function(x) max(abs(x)))
pD<-Heatmap(temp1,name="LFC",clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",show_row_dend = F,
        show_column_dend = F,rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 2),
        row_names_side = "left")
pD<-grid.grabExpr(draw(pD))

```

```{r}
  return.seurat = T,
  group.by = c("SampleName","nosub","has_LA"))

    subset(bulk,subset =nosub==x ))

    deg[[x]]%>%rownames_to_column("pathway")%>%mutate(ct=x))%>%bind_rows()
```

## Markers
```{r}
temp<-metadata%>%filter(dom_nEndoh1_75=="6")
temp<-split(temp,by = "Run_Tissue_name")
get_expre<-function(sample_name){
  fname<-paste0("docs/",sample_name,"asinh.csv")
  mat<-data.table::fread(fname)
  mat<-mat%>%as.data.frame()%>%column_to_rownames("probe")
  mat<-mat[,temp[[sample_name]]$cell_id]
  colnames(mat)<-paste0(sample_name,colnames(mat))
  return(mat)}
dom_mat<-lapply(names(temp),function(x) get_expre(x))
dom_mat<-dom_mat%>%bind_cols()


#could change for deg lfc instead
temp<-dom_mat%>%group_by(Class,Run_Tissue_name,merged_corrected)%>%summarise(across(`4-1BB`:`pan-RAS`,mean))
temp1<-temp%>%ungroup()%>%select(`4-1BB`:`pan-RAS`)%>%scale()
temp1<-temp%>%select(Class:merged_corrected)%>%bind_cols(temp1)
temp1<-temp1%>%pivot_longer(`4-1BB`:`pan-RAS`,names_to = "probe",values_to = "scaled")%>%group_by(Class,merged_corrected,probe)%>%summarise(mean_scaled=mean(scaled))%>%pivot_wider(names_from = Class,values_from = mean_scaled)
temp1<-temp1%>%filter(str_detect(merged_corrected,"theli|Mesen|NK|Plas",negate = T))

markers<-c("CD56","CD138","CD68","CD45","CD4","CD3","FABP4","CD8",
           "Channel-PanCK","Fibronectin","SMA","CD31","CD34","EpCAM")
weird <- scales::trans_new("signed",
                           transform=function(x) ifelse(x>0,
                                                        atan(x),
                                                        sign(x)*sqrt(abs(x))),
                           inverse=function(x) round(atan(x),1))

weird1 <- scales::trans_new("asin_like",
                           transform=function(x) ifelse(x<=1,
                                                        asin(sqrt(x)),
                                                        asinh(sqrt(x))),
                           inverse=function(x) round(sin(x)**2,1))


pD<-temp1%>%filter(!probe%in%markers)%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=`Peritoneal endometriosis`,y=`Eutopic endometrium`,col=merged_corrected))+
    geom_point()+
    geom_text_repel(data = temp1%>%
                        filter(`Peritoneal endometriosis`<=-.5&`Eutopic endometrium`>.5&!probe%in%markers)%>%
                        group_by(merged_corrected)%>%
                        slice_min(`Peritoneal endometriosis`,n=10)%>%
                        slice_max(`Eutopic endometrium`,n=5),
                    aes(x=`Peritoneal endometriosis`,y=`Eutopic endometrium`,label=probe),
                    show.legend = F)+scale_color_manual(values = cellcols)+
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)+theme(legend.position = "none")+
    facet_wrap(~merged_corrected)+
    scale_x_continuous(transform = weird,breaks = c(-.5,0,.5))+
    scale_y_continuous(transform = weird1,breaks = c(0,.5,1,1.5,2))
```

## Sc dotplots
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(readxl)

sc<-readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")
sc<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$Class%in%c("Eutopic endometrium","Peritoneal endometriosis")&
                            !is.na(sc$Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)))
sc@meta.data<-sc@meta.data%>%
  mutate(harmonized_major_cell_type=ifelse(harmonized_major_plus_immune_cell_type=="Early Exhausted CD8 T-cells (2)",
                                           "T cells",harmonized_major_cell_type),
         has_LA=case_when(LA_per_Sample>0~"LA+",
                          LA_per_Sample==0~"LA-",
                          TRUE~Class))

tcells<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$harmonized_major_cell_type=="T cells"))
signatures<-read_excel("../../Downloads/41591_2023_2371_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx",sheet = 5,skip = 1)
signatures<-signatures%>%
  mutate(dummy="lala")%>%
  pivot_longer(-dummy,names_to = "signature",values_to = "gene")%>%
  drop_na()
signatures<-split(signatures,f = signatures$signature)%>%
  lapply(function(x) x$gene)
signatures<-lapply(signatures, function(x) x[x%in%rownames(tcells)])

tcells <- AddModuleScore(stcellsc,features = signatures)
colnames(tcells@meta.data)[173:191]<-str_replace_all(names(signatures)," ","_")
```

### tcells
```{r}
tcells<-subset(sc,cells = which(sc$harmonized_major_cell_type=="T cells"))
i<-tcells@meta.data%>%count(has_LA,Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)%>%
  filter(n>=100)%>%distinct(Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)%>%unlist()
tcells<-subset(tcells,cells = which(tcells$Final_Immune_Cluster_ID%in%i))

signatures<-read_excel("../../Downloads/41591_2023_2371_MOESM3_ESM.xlsx",sheet = 5,skip = 1)
signatures<-signatures%>%
  mutate(dummy="lala")%>%
  pivot_longer(-dummy,names_to = "signature",values_to = "gene")%>%
  drop_na()
signatures<-split(signatures,f = signatures$signature)%>%
  lapply(function(x) x$gene)
signatures<-lapply(signatures, function(x) x[x%in%rownames(tcells)])
signatures$`CGAS-STINGactivation`<-c("TMEM173","CGAS","IFI16","ATM")
signatures$`CGAS-STINGresponse`<-c("CCL5","CXCL9","CXCL10")
tcells <- AddModuleScore(tcells,features = signatures)
colnames(tcells@meta.data)[173:193]<-names(signatures)

temp<-tcells@meta.data%>%select(has_LA,SampleName,Final_Immune_Cluster_ID,
                                `Activation:Effector function`:`CGAS-STINGresponse`)
temp<-split(temp,f = temp$Final_Immune_Cluster_ID)
designM<-lapply(temp,function(x) model.matrix(~0+has_LA+SampleName,data=x)) 

fit<-lapply(names(temp),function(x) 
  lmFit(temp[[x]]%>%select(`Activation:Effector function`:`CGAS-STINGresponse`)%>%t(),
        designM[[x]]))
names(fit)<-names(temp)
cont<-lapply(designM,function(x) makeContrasts(has_LATRUE-has_LAFALSE,levels = x))
fit<-lapply(names(fit),function(x) contrasts.fit(fit[[x]],cont[[x]]))
names(fit)<-names(temp)
fit <- lapply(fit,eBayes, robust=TRUE)
res<-lapply(fit,function(x) topTable(x,number = length(signatures),coef = 1))
res<-lapply(names(res), function(x)
  res[[x]]%>%rownames_to_column("signature")%>%mutate(cell_type=x))%>%bind_rows()
i<-res%>%filter(adj.P.Val<0.05&AveExpr>.1)

temp<-lapply(unique(tcells$has_LA),function(x) DotPlot(subset(tcells,cells=which(tcells$has_LA==x)),group.by = "Final_Immune_Cluster_ID",features = unique(i$signature)))
names(temp)<-unique(tcells$has_LA)
temp<-lapply(names(temp), function(x) temp[[x]]$data%>%mutate(has_LA=x))%>%bind_rows()
pF<-temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=has_LA,y=id,col=avg.exp,size=pct.exp))+geom_point()+facet_grid(~features.plot)+theme_minimal(base_size = 14)+theme(strip.background = element_blank(),strip.text.x = element_text(angle=90,vjust = .5,hjust =0))+scale_color_viridis_c(option = "A")+labs(x="",y="Cell type",col="Average\nexpression",size="Percent\nexpression")

```
